Olbec: The Drunken Alchemist with a Hoot of a Hit
Olbec: The Alchemist of Owl Tower – One Hoot, One Kill?

Olbec is a 4-star Ice (Blue) hero from the Owl Tower event, originally released in late 2023. As a member of the Owl family, he brings the unique "Moonrise" mechanics to the 4-star arena. While his appearance suggests a slightly befuddled scholar who might have sampled his own experiments, his kit is designed for precision sniping and mana disruption. In the current landscape of 2026, he stands as a niche sniper who faces stiff competition from the stat-monsters of recent Covenant and construct summons, but his specific anti-mana utility keeps him in the conversation for specific tournament formats.

Olbec features some of the most personality-filled artwork in the Owl Tower family. With his wide, mismatched "crazy eyes," disheveled plumage, and a flask that definitely doesn't contain water, he perfectly embodies the "Mad Scientist" trope of the avian world. The "drunken owl" aesthetic is a fun departure from the stoic warriors we usually see, adding a bit of levity to your roster. He looks like he woke up five minutes ago and chose violence (and alchemy).

Upon release, Olbec was viewed as a "versatile sniper" with a cool mechanic but was often overshadowed by the sheer power of the 5-star Owls. He was a solid pick for 4-star events but never quite "meta-defining."
The stat gap is real. Facing a team of Constructs or Astral heroes, Olbec feels fragile. His damage, while potentially high, struggles to penetrate the thick defenses of 2025/2026 heroes.

If you pulled Olbec early, he is a fantastic sniper. He will carry you through map stages and early raids, especially against Yellow bosses. Level him up, but prioritize keeping him alive with a healer.

Olbec is a luxury toy. If you play competitively in 4-star tournaments, he is worth having on your bench for specific "Yellow Tank" scenarios or to counter mana-gain teams. However, do not prioritize him over modern stat-monster 4-stars like the Constructs or Toons. He does not need LB2 (Alpha Aethers) unless you are a dedicated Owl fan; LB1 is sufficient for his niche.
The community reaction to Olbec was... mixed.
“This crazy bird is my favorite hero in Owl tower. So happy to get him.”
“Kind of trash. With everyone LB everything very rarely did I get higher than the base damage... He needs to be a hit 3.”
— A common complaint about the Moonrise scaling mechanic.
“I gave Olbec a couple bottles of cheap wine so he will be quiet for a while…”
— A player who benched him immediately for stronger heroes.
The general consensus? Fun art, cool concept, but the damage math often leaves players feeling short-changed against strong teams.

Olbec is the classic case of "Cool Mechanic, Wrong Era." His Moonrise Strike is a fascinating idea that struggles against the stat bloat of 2026. However, he remains a sharp tool for a specific job: deleting Yellow heroes and stopping mana batteries. He's not the king of the owls, but he's certainly the most eccentric member of the parliament.
Keep one for 4-Star Tournaments, but don't expect him to rule the roost.
